alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a pink wall. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a royal blue one stands on the right looking away. Between them on the floor, a plain calendar block reads jan 18, then changes to 18 - 22. A yellow square note pops up on top of it with a bubble that says away. The blue figure turns, its eyes go wide and then close in a smile and it pulses. Both lean in slightly toward each other and the black one smiles. The text stays: 5 days away, on the calendar first. The last card: for whoever puts the dates in before being asked, Choose friction.
